title: Legends' Quest
start: Talk to the guards just outside of the Legends' Guild.

items.t: 3 papyrus (can be obtained during the quest)
An unpowered orb (two if taking the easy way)
2 gold bars (more recommended in case of smithing failure, metal bank does not work)
Clean ardrigal and clean snake weed (can be obtained during the quest)
A cut opal, jade, red topaz, sapphire, emerald, ruby, and diamond
Runes for two casts of any Charge Orb spell (bring more to be safe)
Lockpick, hair clip or a master thief's lockpick (tool belt works)
Unaugmented rune hatchet or better (tool belt works; the hatchet might have to be used on the item)
Runes, depending on your version of RuneScape:
English: 1 soul, mind, earth, and 2 law runes
German: 1 air, blood, nature, and 2 earth runes
French: 1 law, air, death, mind, and blood rune
Portuguese: 1 fire, water, earth, air, and law rune

recommended.t: 43 Prayer (highly recommended for Protect from Melee)
50 Ranged (if wielding holy water against Nezikchened)
5 bittercap mushrooms to activate fairy ring CJS in the Kharazi Jungle
Portable fairy ring for quick access to the jungle if you repair the fairy ring
Weapon, armour, food and several prayer potions
1-10 empty vials to be enchanted during the quest.
Silverlight or Darklight to weaken the demon
A Beast of Burden to carry more items and save trips

rewards.t: Access to the Legends' Guild (including a shop to buy the cape of legends)

7,650 experience each in four skills of your choice amongst the following - Attack, Defence, Strength, Constitution, Prayer, Magic, Woodcutting, Crafting, Smithing, Herblore, Agility, and Thieving (You can choose the same skill multiple times if you wish)
Bull roarer, used to summon Gujuo to bless more golden bowls
Ability to wield a dragon square shield
Access to the Kharazi Jungle and red gecko pets
Chronicle, Book of legends pet (if not already unlocked)

steps.t: Talk to a Legends' guard at the Legends' Guild north-east of East Ardougne (fairy ring BLR). [Chat: 3 Can I speak to someone in charge? › 1 Can I go on the quest? › 2 Yes, I'd like to talk to Grand Vizier Erkle.]
Talk to Radimus Erkle. [Chat: 1 Yes actually, what's involved? › Accept]
If required, take 3 papyrus from Radimus' table. Alternatively, Obli's General Store in the Shilo Village sells 10 papyrus as well.
Chop-down the Jungle Trees/Bushes south of Shilo Village (fairy ring CKR) to access the Kharazi Jungle.
Walk to the western edge of the jungle.
Use the Complete option on the Radimus notes in your backpack.
Repeat in the centre of the jungle.

sub.t: If you have completed A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen, repair fairy ring CJS with five bittercap mushrooms to make returning to the jungle easier.

steps.t: Repeat again on the eastern edge of the jungle.
Return north of the Jungle Trees using fairy ring CKR, or by chopping them down again.
Use the notes on a jungle forester, south of Shilo Village. [Chat: 1 Yes, go ahead make a copy!]
Return to Kharazi Jungle (fairy ring CJS).
Swing the bull roarer to summon Gujuo, this may take several attempts.

Talk to him. [Chat: 1 I was hoping to attract the attention of a native. › 1 I want to develop friendly relationships with your people. › 1 Can you get your people together? › 1 What can we do instead then? › 1 How do we make the totem pole? › 1 I will release Ungadulu...]
Search the mossy rocks in the north-west of the jungle to enter the Viyeldi caves [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll crawl through, I'm very athletic.], this may take several attempts.
Investigate the firewall. [Chat: 1 How can I extinguish the flames? › 1 Where do I get pure water from?]
Exit the cave via the Cave Exit.
Swing the Bull roarer to summon Gujuo.
Talk to him to get the sketch. [Chat: 3/4 I need some pure water to douse some magic flames. › 5 Where is the pool of sacred water? › 5 What kind of vessel? › 2 Ok thanks for your help.]
Re-enter the cave.
Search the eastern bookcase. [Chat: 1 Yes please!]
Search the Ancient Gate.
Smash-to-bits the three boulders. You do not need to keep the rocks that these gives you.
Open the Ancient Gate. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm very strong, I'll force them open.]
Move past the death wings.

sub.t: If you want to complete one of the hard Karamja achievements, you can kill a death wing here.

steps.t: Choose the Jump-over option on the jagged wall.
Search the marked wall. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll read it.]
Use your runes on it in order according to your version:

sub.t: English: Soul, Mind, Earth, Law, Law. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll go through!]
German: Air, Earth, Blood, Earth, Nature.
French: Law, Air, Death, Mind, Blood.
Portuguese: Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Law.

steps.t: If the chat option is not already offered, search the marked wall. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll go through!]
Use (right click so you don't craft them) the cut gems on the carved rocks. Use the map to see which gem goes where.
Take the Binding book.
Make sure you received a sketch from Gujuo, and use 2 gold bars on any anvil for a gold bowl. This may fail.
Return to Kharazi Jungle (fairy ring CJS) and swing the bull roarer.
Talk to Gujuo. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'd like you to bless my gold bowl.]
Travel to the Water Pool (look for the tree icon on minimap).
"Cut-Reed" the Tall Reeds next to it.
Use the acquired hollow reed on the Water Pool.
If you need holy water for the fight against the demon: Choose the Enchant-Vials option on the binding book and create an enchanted vial .
If you need holy water for the fight against the demon: Use the hollow reed on the Water Pool again to fill the vial.
Optional: Take a vanilla pod from one of the five Vanilla plants to the southwest if you intend to do Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze
Return to the Viyeldi caves.
Use the golden bowl on the fire wall.
Use the binding book on Ungadulu.
Kill Nezikchened. He will blast the player sometimes exceeding 2500 typeless damage when he dies.
Talk-to Ungadulu. [Chat: 1 I need to collect some Yommi tree seeds for Gujuo. › 1 How do I grow the Yommi tree? › 1 What will you do now? › 3 Okay, thanks...]
Touch the Fire Wall.
Exit the cave.
Use the Golden bowl on the seeds.
Use the seeds on a patch of fertile soil. There is some just a few tiles north-west of the pool, indicated by a brown patch without grass. You will fail to plant the seeds; this is intended.
Return to the pool and Use the Hollow reed on it. The water will be dried up.

Swing the Bull roarer and Talk to Gujuo. [Chat: 1 The water pool has dried up and I need more water. › 2 Where is the source of the spring of pure water? › 2 If I went, could you help me? › 5 Ok thanks for your help.]
Switch to the standard spellbook if you are not already on it.
Collect the herbs using the maps below.

sub.t: Search palm trees for grimy ardrigal.
Search marshy jungle vines for grimy snake weed.

steps.t: Clean the herbs.
Use the clean ardrigal and clean snake weed on a vial of water for a bravery potion.
Return to the Viyeldi caves.
Traverse the dungeon as before to where you found the Binding book:

sub.t: Search the eastern Bookcase.
Search the Ancient Gate.
Smash-to-bits the three Boulders.
Open the Ancient Gate. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm very strong, I'll force them open.]
Move past the Death wings.
Jump-over option on Jagged wall.
Use the Marked wall.

steps.t: Cast a Charge Orb spell on the north Ancient Gate.
Use the Rope on the Winch.

sub.t: If you forgot your rope, you can smash the barrels in the room for one.

steps.t: Drink the bravery potion. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll bravely drink the bravery potion.]
Search and then climb-down the Winch. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll shimmy down the rope into possible doom.]

Climb-over the rocky ledges and rocks to reach the bottom. You can potentially fall and take upward of 5000 typeless damage during this. [Chat: 1 Yes, I can think of nothing more exciting! › 1 Yes, I can think of nothing more exciting! › 1 Yes, I can think of nothing more exciting! › 1 Yes, I want to climb over the rocks. › 1 Yes, I want to climb over the rocks. › 1 Yes, I want to climb over the rocks.]
Kill the 3 different skeletons until you get 3 crystal pieces (Hunk, Chunk, and Lump):

sub.t: San Tojalon
Irvig Senay
Ranalph Devere

steps.t: Use each crystal on the north-east furnace.
Use the heart crystal on the searchable mossy rock in the middle of the room.
Run south and use the heart crystal on the recess next to the shimmering field.
Walk-through the shimmering field.
West past the lesser demons, push any of the boulders. [Chat: any › 1 What can I do about that? › 1 I'll do what I must to get the water. › 1 Ok, I'll do it.]
Return to the start of the cavern, back past the shimmering field and Rocks.
Equip the dark dagger.
Take the blue hat.
Kill Viyeldi.

sub.t: You will need to Attack him during the dialogue as he will disappear after completing the dialogue.

steps.t: Re-equip your preferred weapon.
Return to the boulders and push one.
Kill Nezikchened.
Push all three boulders.

sub.t: All three must be pushed while standing on the east side of them.
If one does not move, push it from a different angle.
Use Golden Bowl on stream of water that appears.

steps.t: Return to Kharazi Jungle (fairy ring CJS).
Use the hollow reed on the water pool.
Use the yommi tree seeds on the dark brown soil just north-west of the pool, it will appear as Fertile Soil.
Use the golden bowl on it once it stops growing.
Chop the adult yommi tree.
Trim the felled yommi tree.
Carve the trimmed yommi.
Lift the totem pole.
Use your Yommi totem on the Totem Pole east of the pool.
Defeat Nezikchened and the three skeletons.

sub.t: He will appear four times, with a skeleton spawning between each kill.

steps.t: Use the Yommi totem on the Totem Pole again.
Talk to Gujuo to receive the gilded totem.
Return to the Legends' Guild (fairy ring BLR).
Talk to Radimus.
Talk to him again inside the guild. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll train now.]
Quest complete!
